Data extraction: HOCON (HCL dialect) flat key-value pairs

```rust title="Rust"
use tree_sitter_language_pack::process;

fn main() {
    let source = r#"host = "localhost"
port = 8080
"#;
    let config_json: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(r#"{"data_extraction":true,"language":"hocon"}"#).unwrap();
    let config = serde_json::from_value(config_json).unwrap();
    let result = process(source, &config);
    println!("{:?}", result);
}
```
